name: What is AEO and how does it benefit my chiropractic practice?

mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how does it benefit my chiropractic practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or Answer Engine Optimization, focuses on making your chiropractic practice visible in AI-powered search results and voice assistant queries. Unlike traditional SEO, AEO specifically optimizes content to directly answer user questions, ensuring your practice appears as a direct answer or featured snippet. This helps potential patients find information about your services quickly and positions your practice as an authoritative source, driving more qualified leads and appointments. It enhances visibility in emerging search landscapes, crucial for staying competitive.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO optimizes your chiropractic practice's online content to appear as direct answers in AI-powered search and voice assistant results, increasing visibility and patient acquisition.
